section.content: 本实用新型公开了一种用于人工智能机器学习的数据采集装置，包括底板，底板转动装设有转柱，转柱上装设有数据采集设备本体，底板的一端装设有连接杆，固位环内装设有轴承，转柱过盈配合轴承的内圈内壁。因而转柱的下端与底板的上端呈点式接触，因而摩擦阻力小，在通过锥槽与锥头转动配合而承接转柱下部的转动时，对转柱的转动阻力小，通过轴承转动承接转柱的中部，可使转柱转动稳定且顺滑，因而可顺滑且稳定的将数据采集设备本体上的摄像头转动到该数据采集装置的四周进行图像采集，相对需要移动整体数据采集装置来改变其拍摄方向，更加方便，解决了对周围的图像进行采集不方便的问题。

The utility model discloses a data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning, including the bottom plate, the rotary column has been installed in the bottom plate rotation, and the rotary column facial make-up is equipped with the data acquisition equipment body, and the connecting rod has been installed to the one end of bottom plate, has installed the bearing in the maintenance intra-annular, the inner circle inner wall of rotary column interference fit bearing. Therefore the lower extreme of rotary column is the point type contact with the upper end of bottom plate, therefore frictional resistance is little, when accepting the rotation of rotary column lower part through taper groove and conical head normal running fit, the rotational resistance to the rotary column is little, it accepts the middle part of rotary column to rotate through the bearing, can make the rotary column rotate stably and in the same direction as smooth, therefore can be in the same direction as smooth and stable rotate this data acquisition device's the camera with on the data acquisition equipment body and carry out image acquisition all around, relative whole data acquisition device that needs to remove changes its shooting direction, and is more convenient, the problem of gathering inconveniently to the image on every side has been solved.

Data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learningTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning.

Background

The term artificial intelligence was originally proposed at the Dartmouth society of 1956, since then researchers developed many theories and principles, and the concept of artificial intelligence was also expanded, artificial intelligence, abbreviated as AI in english, is a branch of computer science, which attempts to understand the essence of intelligence and produce a new intelligent machine that can respond in a manner similar to human intelligence, including robots, language recognition, image recognition, natural language processing, expert systems, etc., and since birth, artificial intelligence has become increasingly sophisticated in theory and technology, and its application field is expanding, and it is assumed that the scientific and technological products brought by artificial intelligence in the future will be containers for human beings.

The existing artificial intelligence machine collects data through workers, then transmits the data to a logic operation mechanism in the artificial intelligence machine for analysis, thereby achieving the learning effect, the existing data acquisition equipment is internally provided with an image acquisition storage unit and a sound acquisition unit, a camera on the upper part of the existing data acquisition equipment shoots objects to be acquired, then a picture is transferred to the image acquisition storage unit, sound transmitted from the outside can be transferred to the sound acquisition unit through a recording port on the lower part of the existing data acquisition equipment, actually, the data acquisition equipment is mostly carried to the outdoor, sound and image acquisition is carried out in the outdoor, the artificial intelligence can be closer to the actual operation environment, the data acquisition equipment is mostly arranged on a bottom plate, a roller seat is arranged below the bottom plate, and the whole device is conveniently pushed to move to each position for acquisition, the defects are as follows: when the images around the data acquisition equipment need to be acquired, the integral device needs to be pushed, so that the roller seat rolls on the ground, and the shooting direction of the camera of the data acquisition equipment is continuously changed, thereby being inconvenient.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

An object of the utility model is to provide a data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning to propose in solving above-mentioned background and gather inconvenient problem to image on every side.

In order to achieve the above object, the utility model provides a following technical scheme: the utility model provides a data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning, includes the bottom plate, the bottom plate rotates and has installed the rotary column, the rotary column facial make-up is equipped with the data acquisition equipment body, the connecting rod has been installed to the one end of bottom plate, the connecting rod facial make-up is equipped with the retention ring, the bearing has been installed to the retention ring, the inner circle inner wall of rotary column interference fit bearing.

Preferably, the lower surface of the bottom plate is provided with a roller seat.

Preferably, the data acquisition equipment body is provided with a handle.

Preferably, one end of the rotary column is provided with a conical head, the conical head is of a conical structure, one end of the bottom plate is provided with a conical groove, the conical groove is of a conical groove structure, and the conical head is inserted into the conical groove.

Preferably, the connecting rod is of a right-angle rod-shaped structure, and the retaining ring is of a circular annular structure.

Preferably, the bottom plate is provided with a push handle which is of a U-shaped rod structure with a downward opening.

Compared with the prior art, the beneficial effects of the utility model are that: when needing to carry out image acquisition all around to this data acquisition device, the rotation handle, drive rotary column and data acquisition equipment body and rotate, the conical head only bores the point contact with the concave point portion of awl groove, therefore the lower extreme of rotary column is the point type contact with the upper end of bottom plate, therefore frictional resistance is little, when accepting the rotation of rotary column lower part through awl groove and conical head normal running fit, the rotation resistance to the rotary column is little, it accepts the middle part of rotary column to rotate through the bearing, can make the rotary column rotate stably and in the same direction as smooth, therefore can be in the same direction as smooth and stable with the camera rotation of data acquisition equipment body this data acquisition device all around carry out image acquisition, relative need remove whole data acquisition device and change its shooting direction, and is more convenient, the inconvenient image acquisition problem around having solved.

Drawings

In the figure: the device comprises a base plate 1, a roller seat 2, a rotating column 4, a data acquisition device 5, a handle 6, a conical head 7, a conical groove 8, a connecting rod 9, a retaining ring 10, a bearing 11 and a pushing handle 12.

Detailed Description

The technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be described clearly and completely with reference to the accompanying drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are only some embodiments of the present invention, not all embodiments. Based on the embodiments in the present invention, all other embodiments obtained by a person skilled in the art without creative work belong to the protection scope of the present invention.

Referring to fig. 1, fig. 2 and fig. 3, the present invention provides a technical solution: a data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning comprises a bottom plate 1, wherein the bottom plate 1 is of a transversely arranged plate-shaped structure, roller seats 2 are arranged on the lower surface of the bottom plate 1, the roller seats 2 are arranged on four sides of the lower end of the bottom plate 1, the number of the roller seats 2 is four, the four sides of the lower end of the bottom plate 1 are provided, the model of the roller seats 2 is JC-XHJ77, the upper ends of the roller seats 2 are connected with the lower end of the bottom plate 1 in a welding mode, the whole data acquisition device is conveniently pushed to each ground position by rolling the roller seats 2 on the ground on the four sides, a rotary column 4 is arranged on the bottom plate 1 in a rotating mode, the rotary column 4 is of a vertically arranged cylindrical structure, a data acquisition device body 5 is arranged on the rotary column 4, the upper end of the rotary column 4 is connected with the central position of the lower end of the data acquisition device body 5 in, handle 6 is U type rod-shaped structure with downward opening, the lower extreme of handle 6 adopts the welded mode to connect the upper end medial side of data acquisition equipment body 5, the one end of rotary column 4 is equipped with conical head 7, conical head 7 sets up the lower extreme at rotary column 4, conical head 7 is the circular cone structure, the one end of bottom plate 1 is equipped with awl groove 8, awl groove 8 sets up the upper end central point at bottom plate 1 and puts, conical head 7 only bores the tip and contacts with the concave point portion of awl groove 8, therefore the lower extreme of rotary column 4 is the point type contact with the upper end of bottom plate 1, therefore frictional resistance is little, when accepting the rotation of rotary column 4 lower part through taper groove 8 and conical head 7 normal running fit, the rotational resistance to rotary column 4 is little, awl groove 8 is conical groove structure, conical head 7 inserts awl groove 8.

Referring to fig. 1 and 2, a connecting rod 9 is installed at one end of a bottom plate 1, the connecting rod 9 is of a right-angle rod-shaped structure, the number of the connecting rod 9 is two, the connecting rod is arranged on the left side and the right side of the upper end of the bottom plate 1, the lower end of the connecting rod 9 is connected with the upper end of the bottom plate 1 in a welding mode, a retaining ring 10 is installed on the connecting rod 9, the inner end of the upper portion of the connecting rod 9 is connected with the middle of the left side and the right side of the retaining ring 10 in a welding mode, the retaining ring 10 is of a circular annular structure, a bearing 11 is installed in the retaining ring 10, the inner wall of the retaining ring 10 is connected with the outer wall of the outer ring of the bearing 11 in a resin adhesive bonding mode, a rotary column 4 is inserted into the inner ring of the bearing.

Referring to fig. 1, 2 and 3, the bottom plate 1 is provided with two pushing handles 12, the lower ends of the pushing handles 12 are connected to the left and right sides of the upper end of the bottom plate 1 in a welding manner, the pushing handles 12 are of a U-shaped rod structure with a downward opening, and the pushing handles 12 are pushed to enable the roller seat 2 to roll on the ground, so that the whole device can be conveniently pushed to other positions.

The utility model discloses when concrete implementation: the pushing handle 12 is pushed to enable the roller seat 2 to roll on the ground, so that the whole device is conveniently pushed to other positions, when the image acquisition is required to be carried out on the periphery of the data acquisition device, the handle 6 is rotated to drive the rotary column 4 and the data acquisition equipment body 5 to rotate, only the conical tip of the conical head 7 is contacted with the concave tip part of the conical groove 8, so that the lower end of the rotary column 4 is in point contact with the upper end of the bottom plate 1, the friction resistance is small, when the lower part of the rotary column 4 is rotated through the rotary matching of the conical groove 8 and the conical head 7, the rotary resistance to the rotary column 4 is small, the middle part of the rotary column 4 is rotated through the bearing 11, the rotary column 4 can be rotated stably and smoothly, so that the camera on the data acquisition equipment body 5 can be rotated to the periphery of the data acquisition device to carry out the image acquisition, and the whole data acquisition device is relatively required to be moved to change, is more convenient.

Although embodiments of the present invention have been shown and described, it will be appreciated by those skilled in the art that changes, modifications, substitutions and alterations can be made in these embodiments without departing from the principles and spirit of the invention, the scope of which is defined in the appended claims and their equivalents.
